title: Ramsey's theorem for pairs preserves well-foundedness for the induction and collection schemes
source_title: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness

standard_prerequisites.name: The RT22 proposition controlling the jump
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a countable model of RCA_0 plus collection for Sigma^0_2 plus well-foundedness of omega_4 to the alpha, topped by a set Y, and every colouring and every set P above the jump of Y with the model of P satisfying RCA_0-star, there is a homogeneous set G with P above the jump of G plus Y and with the model of G satisfying collection and well-foundedness of alpha; retained with this card at source lines 1356-1363.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted corollary obtains its auxiliary set P and then applies exactly this proposition; the corollary differs from it by replacing collection with an arbitrary induction or collection scheme at a finite level and by dropping the auxiliary set.

standard_prerequisites.name: Omega-extension for finite levels of induction and collection
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof invokes a result attributed to Harrington, Simpson-Smith and Hajek, recorded by Belanger, that every countable topped model of RCA_0-star plus the scheme at level n minus one can be omega-extended into a model of the same theory plus weak Konig's lemma; the citation is carried in the proof and its entry is attached with this card.
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces the set P above the jump of Y whose model satisfies the scheme at level n minus one, which is what the RT22 proposition needs.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transfer of a finite-level scheme along an omega-extension
standard_prerequisites.statement: If a Sigma^0_n formula holds in the extension of G and every such formula is Sigma^0_{n-1} in the model of the auxiliary set P, then satisfaction of the scheme at level n minus one in that model gives satisfaction of the scheme at level n in the model of G; the proof states this transfer in its last two lines.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the step that raises the scheme from level n minus one to level n, which is the difference between the hypothesis and the conclusion of the counted corollary.

core_obligations: Apply the omega-extension result recorded by Belanger to the model of Y extended by its jump, which satisfies the scheme at level n minus one, to obtain a set P above the jump of Y whose model satisfies the same theory plus weak Konig's lemma (source line 1393).

Apply the RT22 proposition to the model, the colouring f and the set P, obtaining a homogeneous set G with P above the jump of G plus Y and with the model of G satisfying collection and well-foundedness of alpha (source line 1393).

Use that every Sigma^0_n formula in the model of G is Sigma^0_{n-1} in the model of P together with the fact that the model of P satisfies the scheme at level n minus one, to conclude that the model of G satisfies the scheme at level n (source lines 1399-1400).

Read off the two asserted properties of the counted corollary: the homogeneity and infiniteness of G, and satisfaction of RCA_0 plus the chosen scheme plus well-foundedness of alpha in the model of G (source lines 1388-1389).

proof_roadmap.step: Produce P by omega-extension, then apply the RT22 proposition to get G.
Transfer the finite-level scheme from the model of P to the model of G by the complexity shift.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Corollary cor:rt22-wf（源 1384-1391 行，证明 1392-1401 行）：把 RT²² 的良基性保持从 BΣ₂ 推广到任意有限的归纳/收集方案 T_n。关键操作不是例行核验：先要用 ω-扩张结果造出满足 T_{n-1} 的 P（1393 行），再对 (M, f, P) 应用 RT²² 命题得到 G；最后一步是全卡的实质——把「M[P] ⊨ T_{n-1}」提升为「M[G] ⊨ T_n」，靠的是「M[G] 里的 Σ⁰_n 公式在 M[P] 里是 Σ⁰_{n-1}」这一复杂度下落（1399-1400 行）。难点在于两层模型之间的复杂度换算与方案层级必须对齐，且 T_n 同时覆盖归纳与收集两种情形。原文位置在证明的 1393 行与 1399-1400 行。
